info.title: Mipyme API
info.description:
Use the Mipyme API to manage a retail or service business. A merchant shares one product catalog across its locations. Record sales and supplier deliveries at each location to track what sold, what arrived, and how much stock is on hand.

## Authentication

Send your access token in the `Authorization` header as `Bearer <token>`. Your merchant membership determines which business you can access. You can call `GET /_health` without a token.

## Request format

Use JSON for request bodies. Realtime channel authorization accepts form fields. Under `/v1`, field names use `snake_case`. Send monetary amounts as decimal strings, such as `"12.50"`.

For a PATCH request, send only the fields you want to change. Omit a field to keep its current value. To clear a field that supports it, send `null`.

## Pagination

Request the first page without a cursor. If `has_more` is true, pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` on the next request and keep the same filters.

## Retries and errors

When a POST operation accepts `Idempotency-Key`, choose a new key for each action and reuse it if you retry that action. If a request fails, use the error `code` to decide what to do next. Check `details` for field-specific issues and keep `request_id` for troubleshooting.

tags.name: Locations
tags.description: A location is a place where a merchant sells products or holds stock. Manage its contact details, receipt text, and checkout settings.

tags.name: Employees
tags.description: An employee can work at a shared point of sale with a PIN. Manage their permissions and location access, or invite them to sign in with a personal account.

tags.name: Invitations
tags.description: Let a signed-in user find and accept an invitation to join a merchant as an existing employee.

tags.name: Realtime
tags.description: Subscribe to a merchant's private channel to receive notifications when its records change.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Identify the user who signed in with an access token.

tags.name: Onboarding
tags.description: Set up a business for a new owner by creating the merchant and its first location.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: A product is a physical item or a service in the merchant's catalog. Use its variants to record sales and track stock for physical items.

tags.name: Collections
tags.description: Group related catalog products under a shared name. Each product can belong to one collection.

tags.name: Suppliers
tags.description: Keep contact details for the people and businesses that supply stock. Each purchase identifies the supplier that provided it.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Keep contact details for buyers and link their sales to the same customer record.

tags.name: Sales
tags.description: A sale records a checkout at one location, including the items sold and payments received. Review fulfillment or void an eligible sale.

tags.name: Purchases
tags.description: A purchase records stock received from a supplier at one location. Use it to track quantities and acquisition costs or reverse a delivery recorded in error.

tags.name: Inventory
tags.description: Track how much of each variant a location holds. Review stock movements and record losses or corrections.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Check whether the API is ready to serve requests.

tags.name: Sync
tags.description: Keep an offline copy of the merchant profile, catalog, customers, suppliers, locations, and employees up to date.

transaction_number.description: The purchase-order number assigned within the receiving location.

location_id.description: The identifier of the location that received the products.

name.description: The display name of the supplier.

supplier.description: The supplier's ID and current name.

unit_cost.description: The acquisition cost per unit recorded on the line, expressed as a decimal string.

price.description: The selling price recorded on the line, expressed as a decimal string. Returns `null` if no price is recorded.

id.description: The identifier of the product variant.

name.description: The display name of the product variant.

quantity.description: The number of units of the variant received in the delivery.

variants.description: The received variants and the quantity of each variant.

id.description: The identifier of the recorded purchase line item.

line_items.description: The products received in the delivery, with costs, prices, and quantities grouped by variant.

notes.description: The staff notes associated with the delivery. Returns `null` if no notes are recorded.

name.description: The display name of the employee.

created_by.description: The employee credited with the delivery, if recorded.

created_at.description: The date and time when the purchase order was created, in RFC 3339 format.

updated_at.description: The date and time when the purchase order was last updated, in RFC 3339 format.

void_reason.description: The reason recorded when the purchase was voided, with surrounding whitespace removed. Returns `null` when no reason was supplied.

name.description: The display name of the employee.

voided_by.description: The employee associated with voiding the purchase. Returns `null` if no voiding employee is recorded.

voided_at.description: The time when the purchase was voided, in RFC 3339 format. Returns `null` until the purchase is voided.

Purchase.description: A delivery received from a supplier, with the quantities and unit costs recorded at the time of receipt.

PurchasePaginationResponse.description: A page of purchases with the information needed to request the next page.

results.description: The purchases returned in this page.

next_cursor.description: The opaque cursor to pass when requesting the next page. Returns `null` on the final page.

has_more.description: Whether more purchases are available after this page.

SalePaginationResponse.description: A page of sales with the information needed to request the next page.

results.description: The sales returned in this page.

next_cursor.description: The opaque cursor to pass when requesting the next page. Returns `null` on the final page.

has_more.description: Whether more sales are available after this page.

reason.description: An optional reason for voiding the purchase, up to 256 characters after surrounding whitespace is removed. Omitted, blank, or `null` values return as `null`.

voided_by_id.description: An enabled employee to credit for the reversal. Omit or send `null` to credit the signed-in employee. Naming someone else does not grant their permissions.

VoidPurchaseRequest.description: An optional reason and the employee to credit for reversing the delivery.

bearerAuth.description: A bearer access token issued by the configured identity provider. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
Use a unique key for each new action. For 24 hours, the same user can replay the original response by sending the same key, path, query values, and JSON body. Keep JSON fields, array items, and repeated query values in the same order.

After `validation_error`, you can correct the request and reuse the key. For `idempotency_request_in_progress`, retry the original request with the same key. Reusing an expired key can run the action again.
